body.label: Effect
body.html: Fold a wall of dense space up to 3 units long until the start of your next turn. It blocks movement and line of sight through its spaces and provides Cover.

body.label: Effect
body.html: On a success, deal 1 weapon damage. If you have at least 1 Combo, you may immediately move 1 unit after the attack.

rider.title: BLITZ
rider.html: If this Action deals damage while you already have Combo, your next Prowess Action this turn gains 1 free Surge.
